content: Bade Isaye suk tuli sadde, tuwangor manuš okkole dórmogóror dan bakšut hitarar nizor nizor sodka raker.
Ar o dekedde, ekzon gorib rari maya fuwaye o he bakšut duiyan foiša raikke.

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ei gorib rari mayafuwawaye beggunottuwaro beši raikke.
Kiyollahoile itara beggune nizor beši šombottittu kissu kissu dan bakšut raikke, kintu hiba obafi oi bade o, hibattu foran basaibolla zin aššil hin beggun di felaiye."

content: Heṛe biššaši okkolor butottu kiye kiye dórmogór babute hoil, hiyan ki šundor šundor fattore edde dan goijjede ziniš loi hãzaiya. Kintu Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ei šob zin dehor, en din aiyer ekkan fattor ar ekkan fattoror uwore no takibo, beggun bangi fela oibo."

content: Toi hitara fusar goredde, "Huzur, in hõtte oibode edde in okkol šuru oibode hẽtte sinno ki?"

content.text: "Saiyo, hono dúhat forizorgoi ne! Kiyollahoile boute ãr namor bed dori aibo, hoibo, 'Ãi Mosi' edde 'šomoi hãse aišše.' Kintu hitarar fise tũwara no zaiyo.
Ar zẽtte tũwara larai edde gonḍugulor hota funiba, hẽtte no ḍoraiyo! Kiyollahoile in okkol hameka foila goṭibo, kintu hehon ze šeš iyan o no."
"Zatir bifokke zati edde raijjor bifokke raijjo tiyaibo.
Ḍõr ḍõr busal oibo edde bout zagat raṭ edde bor biyaram okkol oibo. Ajib goṭona okkol goṭibo edde asmanot ḍor lagede hanḍo edde ḍõr sinno okkol deha oibo.
"Kintu in goṭibar age manuš okkole tũwarare bondi goribo edde zulum goribo, sinagog edde ziyolot faṭaibo. Ar ãr namolla buli tũwarare raza edde šašon goroyar sarme ana oibo.
Hetunot tũwara ãr babute goba diya šuzug oibo.
Kintu tũwara ki zuwab diba hiyanolla agottu loti sinta no goribade hiyan ehon loti dilot yad rako.
Kiyollahoile ãi tũwarar mukot hota zuhai diyum edde giyan diyum, tũwarar bifokkor honokiye tũwarare baron otóba zuwab di no faribo.
Kintu en ki tũwarar bab ma, bái boin, egena fũwajja okkole tũwarare dušmonor hãtot tuli dibo. Ar tũwarar kiyore kiyore hitara mari felaibo.
Mainše ãlla buli tũwarare hingša goribo.
Kintu tũwarar matar ekkan sul o dongšo no oibo.
Tũwarar nizor sofore tũwarar nizor zibon furaiya faiba.
"Ar zẽtte tũwara Zeruzalemore armiye geruwa goijja dekiba, hẽtte hiyan donšo oibar ṭaim hãse aišše de zaniba.
Hetunot zara Ehudiyat take, hitara fahari elehat dai zoggoi, ar zara šohorot take hitara baire dai zoggoi. Ar zara gang zagat take hitara šohorot no aiyok.
Kiyollahoile ehon oilde šazar ṭaim, kitabot ze šob hota leka ase hin furon oibo.
Afsus! He šomot hamilwala mayafuwain edde dudor fuwawala mayafuwain okkololla, kiyollahoile dešot beši durgoti oibo edde ei zatir uwore Allar gozob lami aibo.

Manuš okkol toluwaror tole oi oi moribo edde bondi hisabe hár zatir heṛe loi za oibo. Zetodin Oihudi okkolor ṭaim šeš oi no zagoi hetodin foijjonto Zeruzalemore Oihudi okkole hitar ṭengor tole ḍolibo.
"Ar san surzo asmanor tara okkolot nanan ḍoilla sinno deha zaibo. Duniyait hár manuš okkole zontrona faibo. Doriyar goiror uzore hitara ḍore suhara oi zaiboi.
Duniyait zin goṭibo hinor ḍore manušor foran sulor agat zaiboi, kiyollahoile san, surzo, tara okkol oulzoul oi zaiboi.
Ar he šomot hitara Adomor Futore ḍõr šokti edde mohima loi miyular butottu aiyedde dekibo.
Ei hanḍo beggun šuru oile o tũwara uṛi tiyaiyo, matá tuillo, kiyollahoile tũwarar azadi hãse."

content: Ar Isaye hitarare ei mesal kahanigan hoiye:

content.text: "Ei ḍũir gaswa edde ar har gasor uzu so!
Zehon hinottu noya fata fuṛe, hetunot tũwara hin sai hoi faro horan hal hãse aišše de.
He bafe tũwara o zẽtte ei šob oibode dekiba hẽtte zaniba Allar raijjo hãse aišše.
"Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ze foijjonto in okkol furon no o, he foijjonto ei halor manuš okkolor mout no oibo.
Asman edde zobin šeš oibo, kintu ãr hota hono din šeš no oibo.
"Hũšiyar tako edde tũwarar kolobore beši niša fani hafiyar folai loi edde šongšari sinta loi kobza gori no raikko, zen atikka he din fandor ḍoilla oi tũwarar uwore no fore gai.
Kiyollahoile he dingan duniyair hár manuš beggunor uwore foribo.
Kintu tũwara hamiša seton taikko, munazat goijjo, zene he šob zin goṭibo hin okkolottu dai zaigoi faribolla edde Adomor Futor sarme tiyai faribolla šokti fo."

content: Isaye fotti din dórmogórot zai šikka dito edde fotti raitta hibaye hentu bair oi Zaitun faharot zai takitogoi.
Ar hár manuš okkol Isar hota funibolla kub binna sore dórmogórot zai Isar hãse hazir oito.
